name: The Torrential Turnabout
source:
In the confines of a luxurious and enigmatic manor, nine people are forced to play an insidious "game". You don't know who brought you here or how much time you have left.

Your name is Roland.

In the wake of a natural disaster, an incomprehensible incident unfolds. You resolve to uncover the truth, but the situation continues to spiral further and further out of control.

Your name is Mia Fey.

[i]The Torrential Turnabout[/i] is an [i]Ace Attorney[/i]-style fangame originally made for the Never Trust the Narrator competition which ran in 2016. The game takes heavy inspiration from various mystery visual novels from the late 2000s and early 2010s such as [i]Zero Escape[/i], [i]Danganronpa[/i], and [i]Umineko[/i] and celebrates what it was like to grow up with these stories.

[From [url=http://aaonline.fr/forum/viewtopic.php?t=13387]AAOnline[/url]]
translation:
在一座奢华而神秘的庄园深处，九个人被迫参与一场阴险的“游戏”。你不知道是谁把你带到了这里，也不知道自己还剩多少时间。

你的名字是罗兰。

一场天灾过后，匪夷所思的事件接连上演。你下定决心查明真相，然而事态却一步步滑向彻底失控的深渊。

你的名字是绫里千寻。

[i]《暴雨逆转》[/i]是一款[i]《逆转裁判》[/i]风格的同人游戏，最初为2016年举办的“绝不轻信叙述者”大赛而制作。本作深受2000年代末至2010年代初多部悬疑视觉小说的启发——如[i]《极限脱出》[/i]、[i]《弹丸论破》[/i]与[i]《海猫鸣泣之时》[/i]——旨在致敬伴随这些经典故事一同成长的岁月。

[摘自[url=http://aaonline.fr/forum/viewtopic.php?t=13387]AAOnline[/url]]
